answer: An agent enters an epoch at an admission jetty, locking a bond denominated in copper and committing to a unique work plan hashed with the epoch seed and its address. One ticket issues per commitment; spendable credit unlocks only after established peers, sampled on a willow schedule from a disjoint shard, re-execute the artifact and countersign its fingerprint. Colliding mid-states or failed re-execution merge the accounts and slash surplus bonds. A clone farm posts a full bond per key, cannot finish two re-executable plans from one compute image, and earns no share when peers refuse copies.
